tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Get analyst data for a stock: recommendation trends, upgrades/downgrades, earnings estimates, or earnings history.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Get a time-sorted calendar of upcoming financial events (earnings with estimates, ex-dividend and dividend-payment dates, options expirations, and — when FRED is configured — market-wide economic releases) across multiple symbols. Answers 'what's coming up for my portfolio?' in one call.

tools.name: get_chart
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV candlestick chart data for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol supports start/end absolute timestamps and returns one chart; multiple symbols return a batch of charts plus per-symbol errors (interval/range only, no start/end).

tools.name: get_commodity
tools.description: Get a commodity's current quote (e.g. gold, silver, crude oil), provider-routed (Yahoo, keyless).

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get a company's identity/classification profile (name, description, asset type, exchange, currency, country, sector, industry, market capitalization).

tools.name: get_congressional_trades
tools.description: Get congressional trading disclosures for a symbol. Uses FMP when FMP_API_KEY is set, keyless House PTR filings otherwise.

tools.name: get_crypto
tools.description: Get top cryptocurrency coins by market cap from CoinGecko (no API key required).

tools.name: get_crypto_news
tools.description: Get market-wide crypto news (currently FMP only, requires FMP_API_KEY).

tools.name: get_dividends
tools.description: Get dividend history for one or more dividend-paying stocks (comma-separated symbols). A single symbol returns paginated dividend history plus analytics (CAGR, average payment, payout count); multiple symbols return a batch of dividend histories plus per-symbol errors (no analytics for batch).

tools.name: get_earnings_surprises
tools.description: Get a stock's earnings-surprise history (actual vs. estimated EPS).

tools.name: get_earnings_transcript
tools.description: Get an earnings call transcript for a symbol. Provide quarter and year for a specific call, or omit both for the latest (Yahoo only).

tools.name: get_edgar_facts
tools.description: Get SEC EDGAR XBRL structured financial data (all reported accounting concepts) for a company. Requires EDGAR_EMAIL env var.

tools.name: get_edgar_search
tools.description: Full-text search across SEC EDGAR filings with optional form type and date filters. Requires EDGAR_EMAIL env var.

tools.name: get_edgar_submissions
tools.description: Get SEC filing history and company metadata from EDGAR (up to 1000 most recent filings). Requires EDGAR_EMAIL env var.

tools.name: get_etf_profile
tools.description: Get an ETF's profile and holdings (net assets, expense ratio, sector/country weightings, top holdings).

tools.name: get_executive_compensation
tools.description: Get disclosed executive compensation by year for a symbol.

tools.name: get_fails_to_deliver
tools.description: Get fails-to-deliver records for a symbol. Uses FMP when FMP_API_KEY is set, keyless EDGAR otherwise.

tools.name: get_fear_and_greed
tools.description: Get the CNN Fear & Greed Index — market sentiment from extreme fear (0) to extreme greed (100).

tools.name: get_feeds
tools.description: Fetch RSS/Atom news from financial publishers (Bloomberg, WSJ, MarketWatch, FT, SEC, etc.).

tools.name: get_filing_sections
tools.description: Get sectioned text of one SEC filing by accession number (10-K or 8-K). Routes through EDGAR (best-effort HTML extraction) or Polygon when configured.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get income statement, balance sheet, or cash flow statement for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol returns one statement; multiple symbols return a batch plus per-symbol errors.

tools.name: get_forex
tools.description: Get a currency pair's current exchange rate, provider-routed (Capability::FOREX).

tools.name: get_forex_news
tools.description: Get market-wide forex news (currently FMP only, requires FMP_API_KEY).

tools.name: get_fred_series
tools.description: Get FRED macroeconomic time series data (e.g., FEDFUNDS, CPIAUCSL, GDP, UNRATE). Requires FRED_API_KEY env var.

tools.name: get_futures
tools.description: Get a futures contract's current quote, provider-routed (Yahoo, keyless).

tools.name: get_grading_actions
tools.description: Get provider-routed analyst upgrades and downgrades for a symbol.

tools.name: get_holders
tools.description: Get ownership data for a stock: major holders, institutional/fund ownership, or insider activity.

tools.name: get_index_constituent_changes
tools.description: Get additions and removals from an index's constituent list.

tools.name: get_index_constituents
tools.description: Get an index's current constituent list, provider-routed (Wikipedia, S&P 500 only).

tools.name: get_indicators
tools.description: Get all 42 technical analysis indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Ichimoku, etc.) for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol returns one indicators object; multiple symbols return a paginated batch plus per-symbol errors.

tools.name: get_indices
tools.description: Get world market indices (S&P 500, DAX, Nikkei, etc.), optionally filtered by region.

tools.name: get_industry
tools.description: Get comprehensive industry data (overview, performance, top companies) for a specific industry slug.

tools.name: get_key_metrics_ttm
tools.description: Get trailing-twelve-month key metrics for a symbol.

tools.name: get_market_calendar
tools.description: Get a market-wide event calendar over a date range: earnings, IPOs, dividends, splits, economic releases, market holidays, or live exchange open/closed status. Unlike get_calendar (per-symbol), this spans the whole market.

tools.name: get_market_hours
tools.description: Get current market hours and open/closed status for a region.

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: Get market overview with major indices and currencies for a region.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Get recent news. If a symbol is provided, returns news for that stock; otherwise returns general market news.

tools.name: get_options
tools.description: Get the options chain for a symbol. Provide an expiration timestamp to get a specific expiry, or omit for the nearest expiration.

tools.name: get_press_releases
tools.description: Get a company's own press releases, distinct from get_news (press coverage). Routes through EDGAR 8-K exhibits, falling back to FMP/Alpha Vantage when configured.

tools.name: get_price_target_consensus
tools.description: Get a stock's consensus analyst price target (high/low/mean/median).

tools.name: get_price_target_summary
tools.description: Get analyst price-target counts and averages per window (FMP only, requires FMP_API_KEY).

tools.name: get_protocol_tvl
tools.description: Get a DeFi protocol's total value locked and per-chain split (DefiLlama, keyless).

tools.name: get_protocol_tvl_history
tools.description: Get a DeFi protocol's TVL history, oldest first (DefiLlama, keyless).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get current quote and company data (price, market cap, PE ratio, 52-week range, etc.) for one or more stock symbols (comma-separated). A single symbol returns one quote object; multiple symbols return a paginated batch of quotes plus per-symbol errors.

tools.name: get_rating_consensus
tools.description: Get a stock's consensus analyst rating rollup (strong buy/buy/hold/sell/strong sell counts and a headline consensus label).

tools.name: get_ratios_ttm
tools.description: Get trailing-twelve-month financial ratios for a symbol.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get similar stock recommendations and analyst ratings for a symbol.

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Get risk analytics: VaR (95/99%), Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar ratios, beta, and maximum drawdown for a symbol.

tools.name: get_risk_factors
tools.description: Get risk factors extracted from a symbol's SEC filings. Routes through EDGAR (best-effort HTML extraction) or Polygon when configured.

tools.name: get_sector
tools.description: Get comprehensive sector data (overview, performance, top companies, ETFs) for one of the 11 GICS sectors.

tools.name: get_sector_pe
tools.description: Get price/earnings ratios by market sector, provider-routed (Yahoo screener fan-out, keyless).

tools.name: get_sector_performance
tools.description: Get aggregate performance for every market sector, provider-routed (Yahoo screener fan-out, keyless). Distinct from get_sector (per-sector Yahoo-only shortcut).

tools.name: get_sector_performance_history
tools.description: Get sector performance per session, most recent first.

tools.name: get_short_volume
tools.description: Get daily FINRA short-sale volume for a symbol (keyless).

tools.name: get_spark
tools.description: Get lightweight close-price sparklines for multiple symbols. Faster and smaller than get_charts — use when you only need price direction/trend across many symbols.

tools.name: get_splits
tools.description: Get historical stock split history for a symbol.

tools.name: get_symbol_details
tools.description: Get reference detail for one symbol (name, exchange, SIC code, employees, list date).

tools.name: get_transcripts
tools.description: Get earnings call transcripts for a company. Returns paragraph-by-paragraph text (speaker, timestamp, text), paginated via paragraph_limit/paragraph_cursor since a full call can be tens of thousands of tokens.

tools.name: get_treasury_auctions
tools.description: Get US Treasury securities auction results (bid-to-cover ratio, high yield or discount rate, and the primary-dealer/direct/indirect bidder split), newest first. Set upcoming=true for the announced schedule of auctions not yet held. No API key required.

tools.name: get_treasury_yields
tools.description: Get US Treasury yield curve data (1m through 30y) for a given year. No API key required.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: Get currently trending stock tickers for a region.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Discover tickers filtered by type (equity, ETF, mutual fund, index, future, currency, cryptocurrency).

tools.name: screener
tools.description: Get results from a predefined stock screener (e.g., most-actives, day-gainers, undervalued-growth-stocks).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for stocks, ETFs, and companies by name or ticker symbol.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
